_comment: Baseline v1 configuration. JSON rather than YAML deliberately: the repo has
no YAML dependency and this needs none. Every number here is a decision, and
docs/baseline_v1.md says why each was made.
Nothing in this file trains anything; scripts/train_*.py read it.

detector.reason: one pass gives the box and the four plate corners, which we have exact labels for; the corners rectify the crop before OCR
detector.keypoint_order: plate top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left (clockwise), matching meta.csv quad_1..4

augmentation._comment: Our synthetic set already varies lighting, weather, angle and blur. Heavy colour augmentation on top would blur the type1b decision, which is literally a colour.

recognizer.family: small-cnn + BiGRU + CTC, with a type-classification head
recognizer.reason: one backbone serves both heads; the type head sees the same crop the reader does, so colour and aspect are available to it

crop._comment: type1a is two lines; the upper band and the lower band are cut apart and placed side by side, so a single left-to-right reader handles every class.

evaluation._comment_hash: below this per-character score the character is written as '#', never guessed

target_hardware._comment: A budget to design against and then measure. Nothing here claims it is met.

checkpoints._comment_selection: Model selection never touches real data. Selecting on 13 real images would overfit them and destroy the only real measurement we have.
